F11.finding: Latent option value is real as an outcome dimension, but a generic option-aware t0 retention policy is not established.

F12.finding: Harness durable correction exhibits real mechanical complementarity: promotion and current-selection addressability each provide a partial responsibility; only their composition closes correction. Broad coalition-credit law remains unproven.

F13.finding: No untuned, materially distinct semantic prior-revalidation workload was found; forcing an expiry experiment would encode known F5/F6/F9 failures into the treatment.

knowledgePromotions: Persistence/availability is not evidence of adaptive value.
Change depth is descriptive, not a compounding/value ordering.
Retained priors are model/task-dependent decision-boundary interventions, not neutral capital.
Responsibility placement/future-model robustness is insufficient for externalization; observed mechanical reconstruction burden matters.
Explicit variation is not a default improvement mechanism when direct candidate generation is adequate.
Current consumption and future option value are distinct; option value can exist without a reliable prospective retention rule.

nextFrontier.reopenWhen: A prospective capability portfolio can hide a precommitted future workload distribution and measure carrying/reacquisition regret.
A natural environment exhibits false local self-reinforcement under an unregulated arm.
A materially different workload has feasible A/B/A+B/neither interventions and an independent outcome.
An earned semantic prior naturally crosses a model/task-family change with a new independent oracle.
A real migration/self-change episode creates competing inheritance policies.
Materially different owner-generated pressure signals exist beyond the negative C6 setup.

nonAuthority: This closeout does not authorize Runtime/Host/Harness/World/Workstation/domain changes, PALController, improvement score, automatic retention, global prior registry, coalition-credit service, or RSI architecture.
scope: Computing-local PAL foundational research only; no owner reform.
worldModelDelta: PAL is not a monotone accumulate-and-compound process. Retention can create bias, externalization can be redundant, and variation can move rather than remove a bottleneck.
Adaptive value must be judged on later consumption/outcome plus cost and interaction structure, not persistence, recursion depth, or abstraction prestige.
Current-use deletion heuristics are incomplete because latent option value and composition both exist, but neither justifies speculative retention.
The next foundational bottlenecks are uncertainty-aware option valuation, endogenous regulation, cross-domain interactional credit, identity under change, and reliable pressure selection.
